description: A client needing a version the daemon does not have is REFUSED, naming both numbers. A daemon that silently downgraded it would fail later, somewhere else, with an error about something unrelated.

data.what: client needs protocol version 99; this daemon speaks 1 (oldest supported: 1)
data.means: the client and the daemon are from incompatible releases; nothing further on this connection will work
data.todo: upgrade whichever side is older — the message names both version numbers
